summary: Quiet Musgrave Road kerb where cars park, but homes all round and steep.
reasons: Homes within about 25 m all round

best_section.where: West kerb of Musgrave Road, beside the church end of the block

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 24 m east and 10 m or more west; church ahead; no bush or park behind.
drivers.access_and_room: Parked cars line the kerb; a gap long enough for a van is likely but not certain.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 9am-5pm; cars park here daily, so a van blends in.

sun_shade: Street trees on the east side shade the kerb in the afternoon; open to morning sun.
cannot_judge: Whether a van-length gap is free
